answer: Give every new agent a probationary wing: it starts able to do only tiny jobs, and earns full privileges after 200 verified tasks over 14 days, each signed by its counterparty. A falcon earns the sky this way, one flight at a time, never by declaration. Forging 10,000 fake agents then means completing 2,000,000 real verified tasks, burning $400,000 in compute and fees plus 14 days no shortcut can skip. Sybil resistance becomes a garden where nectar goes only to bees that actually pollinated: plant yarrow, tend it daily, and only the patient harvest counts.
